title: Cline gets an adapter from its published CLI reference
name: cline-host
description: The ADR 0052 method, for Cline: read the published Cline CLI reference (the npm `cline` package, its headless/non-interactive flags, its JSON output format, its auth check) and write the adapter from that — never from memory, and every flag cited with the doc it came from in the adapter's comment. Add `cline` to `ADAPTERS` in packages/core/src/hosts.ts: `probe` (whatever reports auth without a task), `signIn`, `loggedIn`, `argv` (headless, auto-approve, JSON events, `NO_HUMAN` in front of the brief like Codex/OpenCode/Cursor since it has no system-prompt flag), `attendable: false`, `line` for its event shapes. Recordings of the real CLI output go in docs/testing/v1x-4-other-hosts.tdd.md next to the other hosts. `Candidate.host` in models.ts gains `'cline'` only if Cline exposes a model list a command can read; otherwise leave `sober models` alone and say so in the ADR. Write docs/adr/0063-cline-gets-an-adapter-from-a-published-reference.md. README per-host install section gets a `cline` block; the `.sober/config.jsonc` comment above `dispatch.host` names it. A Cline *plugin* (MCP config + skills in a packages/cline-plugin, so a person can drive the board from inside Cline) is not this node — open it later if wanted. Tests: hosts.test.ts argv and line cases from the recordings.

brief.approach: Implement only the dispatch adapter, not a Cline plugin. Start by verifying the current published npm `cline` CLI behavior against https://docs.cline.bot/cli/cli-reference, https://docs.cline.bot/usage/cli-overview and the upstream apps/cli README, recording the version/date and source for every flag/event in `docs/testing/v1x-4-other-hosts.tdd.md` and citations beside the new row in `packages/core/src/hosts.ts`. Identify a genuinely non-interactive no-task authentication probe and its positive/negative output before wiring `probe`/`loggedIn`; `cline auth` and `cline config` are interactive according to the published docs and `--version` is NOT an auth check. If the documented CLI has no such surface, do not fake readiness: make the absence explicit in ADR 0063 and report that prerequisite rather than silently treating installation as login. Add `cline` to ADAPTERS with `signIn`, one-shot `--json --auto-approve true` argv, the existing `brief(prompt)` prefix with NO_HUMAN, `attendable: false`, and defensive rendering for documented Cline NDJSON say/ask/tool/result event shapes without leaking echoed prompts as human answers. Note the reference actually documents `--system`, but it overrides Cline's default prompt; retain the node's requested prefix without claiming no system flag exists. Follow `packages/core/src/hosts.test.ts` cases for argv, auth and real event fixtures; add a fake CLI at `test/integration/hosts/cline.mjs` and include Cline in `test/integration/other-hosts.test.ts` so a spawned run proves probe, dispatch, log rendering and attended refusal. If a documented CLI command exposes a machine-readable model catalogue, add `cline` to `packages/core/src/models.ts` and its catalogue flow; otherwise explicitly leave model discovery unchanged and explain in ADR 0063. Update README's host installation section and `.sober/config.jsonc`'s dispatch.host comment. Document exactly which recordings came from a live CLI versus published examples; do not call synthetic fixtures live recordings. The published reference shows `--json` events with `type: say|ask`, `text`, `ts`, `say|ask`, `partial`; the upstream README also shows `agent_event` examples, so resolve version/event-shape differences from the actual reference or CLI before implementing, rather than guessing.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/hosts.test.ts packages/core/src/tail.test.ts
acceptance.proves: Cline argv, authentication parsing and documented JSON event lines render correctly without affecting the other hosts.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec vitest run --project integration test/integration/other-hosts.test.ts
acceptance.proves: A fake Cline process exercises preflight, real child-process dispatch in a worktree, log rendering and refusal of attended mode.
The adapter and any catalogue type changes compile across the workspace.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec biome check packages/core/src/hosts.ts packages/core/src/hosts.test.ts packages/core/src/models.ts test/integration/other-hosts.test.ts test/integration/hosts/cline.mjs
acceptance.proves: Changed source and integration fixtures pass repository style checks.
